evidence.activity: Produces marketing content (a podcast, demo videos and educational books) to support selling its security platform
evidence.quote: Our approach to content includes producing our own Security Visionaries Podcast, creating use case demo videos, and writing educational books such as The Cyber Savvy Board Room.

creativity.criterion: level 1: creative work used only as a routine business input (marketing content)

creativity.reason: Level 1: the business is cybersecurity and networking software, and creative work appears only as marketing content (a podcast, videos and books), which is a routine business input.

community.reason: Level 1: rests on general language only; the human capital and culture sections give a value statement ('Strengthen our Communities') but describe no specific employee development, external education or community investment activity.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 1: rests on general language only; the culture section's 'Cultivate Belonging' value statement describes no specific inclusion practice, accessibility feature or community program.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: rests on general language only; the filing shows only the company's own innovation and enterprise/mid-market customers, with no service or program that enables founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: Final score = 7 + 6 + 4 + 3 = 20/100. Coverage is marked sufficient for Community and Cross-cultural because the filing has an Employees and Human Capital Resources section plus a Culture section, together well over 150 words. That discussion is mostly values language (GRIT, seven cultural traits), and it does not point to a sustainability report. Excluded as traps or non-qualifying: (1) Netskope Threat Labs 'contributes to the global security community', and its researchers are 'presenters and volunteers at top security conferences', which is professional/industry community activity, not external education or community investment. (2) NewEdge Localization Zones serve 'local content, in the appropriate local language', which is a network/geo-routing feature for resilience and data sovereignty, not an inclusion or multilingual-access program. It was considered and judged below level 2 when torn. (3) International expansion (EMEA, APJ, Latin America) is international operations only. (4) Item 7 'educate potential customers' is marketing. (5) 'Mid-Market' customers (fewer than 2,000 employees) are not small-business enabling. (6) Threat Labs leaders' 'experience founding... companies' and 'Innovate Boldly' are own innovation or entrepreneurial culture. (7) 'Design' in R&D refers to engineering.
